claim.value: If results are inconsistent at the trial's end, more observation or a revised test is required.
claim.scope: Conditional response at final trial review; the mapping does not select between the two responses.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the review context, inconsistent-results condition and both permitted responses.

signal_basis.value: The field trial is assessed against predeclared comparison bookings and a success rule, tracking lateness and operational consequences; its final review finds inconsistent results.
signal_basis.scope: Evaluation of the bounded field trial using existing-service deadlines.

provenance.rationale: Together the spans specify the evaluation framework and the inconsistent-results condition at final review.
The supported procedural claim requires no additional empirical bridging relation.

rationale: Inconsistent trial results leave the assessment unresolved and warrant further observation or revision of the test before rollout. Within its explicit procedural scope, the claim is licensed without establishing a remedy or selecting between those responses.
uncertainty: The signal does not determine which response is preferable or whether either will resolve the inconsistency; the claim asserts neither.
